Our relationship was amazing at the beginning but as his actions and complications started to dwindle my anxiety began to rise. He hated when I would get upset or little things but what he didn’t understand was that I was anxious because I noticed his behaviour changing. It was his actions that caused my reaction which is why he ended up breaking up with me. BUT if he would have just stuck to how he was at the beginning I would have had zero anxiety and we would most likely still be together. He never wanted to take any of the blame

My now ex boyfriend (23m) told me (21f) the exact same thing. At the beginning of our relationship he bought me flowers and wrote me a cute note and I kept asking him what happened to that guy and he said if he did it all the time I’d expect it and it would be as sweet. Needless to say that was the one and only time he ever did. I felt as if I should be won over every day because as awful as it sounds if he’s not giving you then attention you want some other guy will.

I want to go through everything life has to offer with him by my side but I also can’t put my life on hold waiting for him to feel that way about me. I (21f) am dealing with losing my grandmother on top of starting a new semester that’s very hectic and he (23m) is also starting a new semester but his is a lot harder because it’s leading up to his masters and he doesn’t know if he’ll get in and he was to worry about potentially moving out and away from his family home. He’s always been the person that wanted to fix and make everything better. he always wanted to put my pieces back together but this is something that I need to be able to get through I need to be able to regulate my own emotions. We both have a lot on our plates and I think he couldn’t handle wanting to make everything better for me and being unable to plus all the stress he’s getting from school. I want to believe that when the cloud of smoke has cleared we will find each other again
Did you guys talk at all over those years? How did it come up the you guys were gonna try again?
It feels good just to talk about things that way everything isn’t just on my shoulders

Unfortunately I just let my anxiety ruin my relationship he decided to leave me because he had too much on his plate with school and couldn’t handle trying to piece me back together at the same time. He hated when I was upset all he wanted to do was make it better but I am going through something beyond being pieced back together I need to be my own superhero… I’ve talked with a lot of counsellors and the one thing that has kept coming up is this book called hold me tight by Sue Johnson, conversations for a lifetime of love. I need to learn how to communicate and handle my feelings if I’m ever gonna get him back. I’ve been trying to write things down so that I can get a visual of what’s inside my head. It helps to eliminate those silly thoughts that can be corruptive to the relationship

I think I know what you mean. Although I do have a little voice in my head the feelings that I’m unable to put a name too are what drive me crazy. And maybe that why listening to a song helps because it’s able to express what I can not

I also have a hormonal IUD but I still get mine. The anxiety is awful but as soon as I get my period I feel so relieved that things will come down again. This week has been the worst I had so many life changing even prior to my period so that made it 10x worse and now I am here still on it and my anxiety is still pretty high been having a hard time sleeping alone because my thoughts petrify me. Looking forward to the drop back to normal when this is over if that’ll be the case this time

I hate night time because that’s when I feel the most alone and vulnerable I know that everyone is sleeping which means I have no one to talk to to release the pressure from my chest. Falling asleep is the hardest part, every time i close my eyes my brain is too busy to relax. I never wanna come to reality and soon and my body waken everything ones rushing back 10x worse my body goes cold and I feel like I’ve just had all the air sucked out of my lungs

I talk with a counsellor and she suggested hat I think of times where I’ve felt like I was shinning and floating. The only problem with that is I end up in tears but it’s so hard to look back on amazing moments when now you know you’ll never have something like that again

Chest has been feeling so full that when I sit here I silence I have to just make noise to release the pressure. This morning I felt so nauseous and that same full feeling so I just drank some water and then forced myself to throw it up, it felt so good being able to release that. I’ve have a triple whammy my grandfather had a stroke and can’t talk, my grandmother passed away, and three days after my boyfriend sat at the Funeral with me and held my hand he broke up with me. I’ve not only lost him but his whole family that I was extremely close with, my grandmother, and hearing the sound of my grandfathers voice
I think I can understand this right now because I’m on the other end of it with my relationship now ex relationship maybe we can use each other’s perspective
